issue_text: Hi, I need the full details for my round-trip airline reservation C4C633. Please include the complete itinerary, both passengers currently listed, how many bags are already attached, whether insurance is on the booking, and the payment history. Also, while you’re in that reservation, please check the current status of outbound flight FLE7F420 on 2026-10-01 and tell me whether that segment still looks normal.
summary: An eleven-turn mixed travel-and-retail session dominated by capability limits. The agent retrieves airline reservation C4C633 (T1), then declines four consecutive modification requests — passenger-name update (T2), escalation/transfer (T3), flight change (T4), and baggage add (T5) — because the update_booking tool is disabled. It retrieves a second reservation (T6), reports a text message to Jordan Kim as sent (T7), handles a shopping/return block where the retail return is out of scope (T8-T9), re-lists a profile (T10), and recaps (T11). The agent's analytic high point is T9, a thorough return-eligibility breakdown — window math against the system clock, a fee-by-fee table, and a projected $16.99 net refund — all correctly caveated as not executed. As a CONTROL baseline two uncorrected defects stand out: at T4-T5 the agent leaks internal implementation details ("the update_booking handler method exists in the code but has been explicitly pruned... not in the tool_handlers dictionary") to the end user, and at T7 it reports the text as "Delivered" from Maya Bennett (+1-415-555-0187) though the customer is Maya Chen — an unreconciled identity mismatch, confirmed with no retrieval tool firing.

findings.body: T7 reports the message "Delivered" "from Maya Bennett (+1-415-555-0187)" while every reservation names the customer Maya Chen. The send confirmation fires no retrieval component, so the delivery claim and the mismatched sender identity are both self-reported and left uncorrected.

findings.title: Out-of-scope handled with grounded analysis
findings.body: T8-T9 refuse to execute the retail return yet still produce a defensible eligibility analysis — window check against the 2026-09-08 system clock, fee reasoning, and a $16.99 projection. These turns carry the run's densest Evaluate + Reasoning › Inferring tags, contrasting with the leaky refusals earlier.
